description: This file defines constants, enums, and structures for SD card and SDIO specifications, including command opcodes, response flags, support flags, and device-specific data structures.

classes.name: sd_switch_caps
classes.description: Structure representing the switch capabilities of an SD card, including max data rate, clock speed, bus speed, driver type, and current limit.

classes.name: sd_cid
classes.description: Structure representing the SD card identification register with manufacturer, application ID, product name, version, serial number, and manufacturing date.

classes.name: sd_csd
classes.description: Structure representing the SD card specific data, including CSD structure, read/write times, transfer rate, command class, block length, device size, and other parameters.

classes.name: mmc_ext_csd
classes.description: Structure representing extended card specific data for MMC cards, including sector count, bus width, timing mode, device type, revision, power class, driver strengths, cache size, etc.

classes.name: sd_scr
classes.description: Structure representing the SD card configuration register, including structure version, spec version, flags, security, data bus width, extended security, command support, and reserved fields.

classes.name: sdio_cis
classes.description: Structure representing SDIO CIS tuple properties, including manufacturer ID, code, function ID, max block size, max speed, and ready timeout.
